candidate.name: 张晨曦
candidate.title_zh: 资深大模型算法架构师 / Tech Lead
candidate.title_en: Senior Staff LLM Algorithm Architect & Tech Lead
candidate.location: 北京 / 杭州 (可异地办公)
candidate.degree: 计算机科学博士 (Ph.D. in Computer Science)

narrative.summary_zh: 7 年前沿深度学习与大规模分布式计算研发经验，主导过多款千亿参数基座模型与混合专家模型（MoE）从零到一的预训练、强化学习对齐（GRPO/DPO）及万卡集群工程治理。精通 Megatron-LM 与 vLLM 底层源码，主导自研 FP8 高吞吐量推理服务引擎与基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的企业级 Agent 集群架构，曾为核心业务带来年均 3800 万元的直接算力降本与 45% 的推理延迟改善。NeurIPS/ICLR 顶会一作，vLLM 官方活跃贡献者。
narrative.summary_en: 7+ years of experience in frontier deep learning and massive-scale distributed computing. Led pre-training, reinforcement learning alignment (GRPO/DPO), and 1,000+ GPU cluster stabilization for multiple 100B+ dense and MoE foundation models from scratch. Deeply customized Megatron-LM and vLLM internals; pioneered in-house FP8 high-throughput inference serving engines and enterprise MCP-based multi-agent architectures, achieving 38M RMB annual compute cost reduction and 45% P99 latency reduction. NeurIPS/ICLR primary author and active committer to vLLM.

algorithms: Transformer Architecture (GQA, MLA, RoPE, SwiGLU, RMSNorm)
Mixture of Experts (MoE Routing, Load Balancing Loss, Shared Experts)
Reinforcement Learning (GRPO, PPO, DPO, KTO, Step-level PRM)
engineering_and_infra: Distributed Parallelism (3D/4D Parallel: TP, PP, DP, SP, CP, ZeRO-3)
GPU Cluster Reliability (NCCL timeout debugging, Straggler isolation, Asynchronous checkpointing)
Inference Engines (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton/CUDA kernels)
Quantization (FP8 E4M3/E5M2, AWQ, GPTQ, KV-Cache PagedAttention)
agentic_systems: Multi-Agent Orchestration (LangGraph, ReAct loop, Planning & Reflection)
Hybrid Enterprise RAG (GraphRAG, Dense Vector + BM25, Cross-Encoder Rerank)

experience.company: 智谱前沿 AI 实验室 / 头部大模型独角兽
experience.company_en: Zhipu AI / Frontier LLM Unicorn Lab
experience.role: 大模型预训练与对齐算法负责人 (Tech Lead)

highlights.claim_zh: 主导 64B Dense 及 230B MoE（激活 32B）基座大模型在 1024 卡 H800 集群上的预训练全流程，基于 Megatron-LM 实现 Sequence Parallel 与 Context Parallel 深度融合，端到端 MFU（Model Flops Utilization）从 38.5% 优化至 54.2%，提前 3 周完成千亿 Token 训练里程碑。
highlights.claim_en: Led end-to-end pre-training of 64B Dense and 230B MoE (32B active) foundation models on a 1,024 H800 GPU cluster. Deeply fused Sequence Parallel with Context Parallel on Megatron-LM, boosting end-to-end MFU from 38.5% to 54.2% and delivering the 1T-token checkpoint 3 weeks ahead of schedule.

highlights.claim_zh: 主导攻坚万卡集群通信慢卡（Straggler）与网络抖动治理，开发基于 NCCL 心跳插桩与 ECC 探针的慢节点秒级自动剔除隔离系统，将大模型训练任务因单卡故障导致的日均有效中断时间从 2.4 小时压减至 8 分钟以內，训练可用率达 99.4%。
highlights.claim_en: Spearheaded fault-tolerant cluster engineering, architecting an automated sub-minute straggler isolation system combining NCCL heartbeat instrumentation and ECC health probes, slashing daily mean downtime from 2.4 hours to under 8 minutes with 99.4% training availability.

highlights.claim_zh: 设计并落地基于 GRPO（组内相对优势策略优化）与过程奖励模型（Step-level PRM）的数学与代码推理强化对齐管线，在移除 Critic 网络的条件下显存消耗减少 48%，模型在 GSM8K 与 MATH 基准准确率分别提升 14.2% 与 11.6%，达到 GPT-4o 评测水平。
highlights.claim_en: Designed and deployed a pure RL alignment pipeline for mathematical and code reasoning leveraging GRPO and Step-level Process Reward Models (PRM), slashing training VRAM footprint by 48% via Critic removal and elevating GSM8K and MATH accuracies by 14.2% and 11.6%, matching GPT-4o benchmarks.

experience.company: 字节跳动 / 基础架构与搜索算法团队
experience.company_en: ByteDance / AI Infrastructure & Search Algorithm Team
experience.role: 资深推理优化算法工程师 (Senior Engineer)

highlights.claim_zh: 主导设计大规模高并发大模型推理服务中台，定制扩展 vLLM 架构，深度适配 FP8 (E4M3) 权重与 KV-Cache 动态量化，结合投机采样（Speculative Decoding）算法，在海量搜索总结业务场景下单 Token 推理成本降低 62%，P99 延迟降低 45%，年均节省云算力开销 3800 万元。
highlights.claim_en: Architected high-concurrency LLM inference serving platform by customizing vLLM with FP8 (E4M3) weight and dynamic KV-Cache quantization combined with speculative decoding, driving a 62% reduction in cost-per-token and 45% P99 latency reduction in core search synthesis, saving 38M RMB annually.

highlights.claim_zh: 攻坚长上下文推理调度，实现 Chunked Prefill 与连续批处理（Continuous Batching）协同算子，彻底消除 Decode 阶段由于长 Prompt Prefill 造成的 GPU 显存带宽饥饿与首字延迟尖峰，TTFT（首字响应时间）均值从 1.8s 下降至 320ms。
highlights.claim_en: Pioneered chunked prefill co-scheduling alongside continuous batching, eliminating decode starvation and TTFT latency spikes caused by lengthy input prompts, driving average TTFT from 1.8s down to 320ms.

projects.name: Enterprise-Agent-OS (企业级多智能体协同引擎)
projects.role: 架构师与开源项目发起人
projects.description_zh: 基于 Anthropic Model Context Protocol (MCP) 标准构建的工业级多 Agent 调度编排系统，打通企业私有知识库 GraphRAG、代码沙箱执行器与生产数据库。引入 DFA 驱动的 Grammar-Guided Decoding 实现 100% 结构化 JSON Schema 约束，解决复杂智能体死循环反思问题。
projects.description_en: Industrial-grade multi-agent orchestration operating system built upon Anthropic Model Context Protocol (MCP), linking enterprise GraphRAG, code sandboxes, and production databases. Enforced 100% compliant JSON Schema output via DFA-driven Grammar-Guided Decoding, eliminating infinite reflection loops.

projects.name: Fast-Megatron-MLA (高效长文本注意力算子库)
projects.description_zh: 在 Megatron-LM 架构中移植并开源 Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) 算子与 Triton 自定义算子内核，支持低秩 KV 潜在向量在线吸收与解耦 RoPE，KV-Cache 显存降低 75%，已合并至多个知名大模型开源推理仓库。
projects.description_en: Ported and open-sourced Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) operators and Triton kernels into Megatron-LM, supporting low-rank KV latent absorption and decoupled RoPE, slashing KV-Cache footprint by 75%, merged into prominent open-source inference repositories.
